in_marathi.name: Jignansh
in_marathi.long_meaning: Jignansh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Jignansh is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Jignana' (knowledge) and 'Ish' (lord). This name represents the divine knowledge bestowed by the lord, signifying a wise and learned individual.
